section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: INSPECTION OF NEUTRAL START SWITCH CIRCUIT
ocr_text:
BE-80

BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System

G    INSPECTION OF NEUTRAL START SWITCH CIRCUIT

Turn ignition switch on.

NEUTRAL START S/W

INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
Is there continuity between terminal 2 and
body ground?

No    Open circuit in wire harness between
       terminal 2 and body ground.

Yes

COMPUTER

INSPECT NEUTRAL START SWITCH CIRCUIT
Disconnect connector from computer.
Is there continuity between terminal 11 of wire
harness side connector and body ground when
shifted to "N" range?

No    • Open circuit in wire harness between
       terminal 11 of computer and terminal 3
       of neutral start switch.
     • Inspect neutral switch.

Yes

Replace computer.
